defaults.WorkspaceName: Display name of the workspace at extraction time.
defaults.WorkspaceId: Unique workspace identifier. Use this, rather than the name, to match workspace records.
defaults.WorkspaceType: Workspace type returned by the admin API, such as Workspace or PersonalGroup. See WorkspaceHostingMode for its hosting/licensing classification.
defaults.WorkspaceHostingMode: Derived hosting classification, such as Fabric, Premium, Embedded, PPU or shared capacity. This is separate from the API's WorkspaceType.
defaults.CapacityId: Identifier of the capacity associated with this record. Blank means no capacity was supplied by this source.
defaults.CapacityName: Display name of the workspace's assigned dedicated capacity. Blank for shared capacity or unavailable capacity metadata.
defaults.CapacitySku: Capacity size/product code, such as F8 or P1, when returned. It is not a measure of actual consumption.
defaults.WorkspaceAdmins: Direct workspace Admin assignments, separated by semicolons. This is an administrator/contact proxy, not the configured workspace contact list or expanded group membership.
defaults.PrincipalDisplayName: Source display name of the user, group or application identity with access. Names are not guaranteed to be unique.
defaults.PrincipalEmailOrUpn: Email address or user principal name where available; otherwise the source identifier. Group/application entries can contain an ID rather than an email address.
defaults.PrincipalIdentifier: Principal identifier returned by the API. It can be an email/UPN or an ID, depending on the principal type.
defaults.PrincipalObjectId: Microsoft Entra object identifier supplied by the source, when available. No directory lookup was performed to fill missing values.
defaults.PrincipalType: Identity category: Individual, AD Group, Service Principal, Service Principal Profile or Entire Tenant; unrecognized source labels are retained.
defaults.DirectoryUserType: Directory user category, such as Member or Guest, if the API supplies it. This is not the workspace Member RBAC role.
defaults.WorkspaceRole: Direct workspace role: Admin, Member, Contributor or Viewer. A group appears as one assignment; its members are not expanded.
defaults.State: Workspace lifecycle state returned by the API. This extract selects active workspaces, not deleted-workspace history.
defaults.IsOrphaned: True only when scanner data confirms a role-assignable workspace has no direct Admin assignment. Blank for personal/system workspaces or unavailable scanner data.
defaults.IsReadOnly: Read-only indicator returned for the workspace. This is a workspace property, not a statement that a particular principal has Viewer access.
defaults.IsOnDedicatedCapacity: Whether the API reports that the workspace is assigned to dedicated capacity.
defaults.DefaultDatasetStorageFormat: Default semantic-model storage format reported for the workspace. It does not establish the format or size of every model.
defaults.HasWorkspaceLevelSettings: Whether the API reports workspace-level settings. The individual settings are not enumerated here.
defaults.DashboardsCount: Number of dashboards found for this workspace by the scanner. Blank means unavailable. This workspace total repeats on each access-assignment row.
defaults.ReportsCount: Number of reports found for this workspace by the scanner. Blank means unavailable. Do not sum repeated workspace totals across access-assignment rows.
defaults.DatasetsCount: Number of semantic models/datasets found for this workspace by the scanner. Blank means unavailable; totals repeat across workspace access rows.
defaults.LargeModelCount: Number of workspace semantic models at least 1 GiB, only when size metadata is complete. Blank means size could not be established, not zero large models.
defaults.LargeModelSizeDataAvailable: Whether size metadata is complete enough to calculate LargeModelCount. Workspaces with no models can also have a valid zero count.
defaults.LargeStorageFormatCount: Number of workspace models using PremiumFiles (large storage format). This setting does not prove that each model exceeds 1 GiB.
defaults.LargeStorageFormatModel: Names of workspace models using PremiumFiles, separated by |. This lists storage-format settings, not measured sizes.
defaults.DataflowsCount: Workspace dataflow count from the scanner. Blank means unavailable; the same workspace count repeats across access rows.
defaults.FabricItemsCount: Count of Fabric-native workspace items, excluding Power BI reports, semantic models, dashboards, apps and datamarts. This is not the total row count of the Items tab.
defaults.DiscoveryStatus: Complete or Partial for the workspace discovery record. Read DiscoveryErrors before treating missing fields as genuinely empty.
defaults.DiscoveryErrors: Explanation of unavailable or failed workspace discovery data. Blank when no discovery error was recorded.
defaults.ItemId: Unique item identifier within the source inventory. Match with WorkspaceId where supplied.
defaults.ItemName: Item display name returned by the source. Names can change and are not unique identifiers.
defaults.ItemType: Item type used by this extract, such as Report, SemanticModel or Notebook. In Items, the Fabric and scanner source labels are retained separately.
defaults.FabricItemType: Unmodified item-type label from Fabric Admin Items. Blank when this identity was not present in that source.
defaults.ScannerItemType: Item-type label from workspace scanner metadata. Blank when this identity was not present in that source.
defaults.Sources: Sources in which the workspace/item identity was observed, separated by |. A single source is not automatically a collection error.
defaults.AppId: App identifier supplied by the source. In item inventory, it is an app association where supplied, not proof that the item is currently published.
defaults.OriginalReportId: Source report identifier for a published/report copy, when returned. It can differ from the copy's own report or published-item ID.
defaults.DatasetId: Related semantic-model/dataset identifier, when the source supplies it. Blank is not proof that no model exists.
defaults.CollectionStatus: Status of collecting or reconciling this item record. Check source labels and Collection Notes before interpreting missing fields.
defaults.ReportId: Unique report identifier reported by the source. App-published copies can have a different identifier from their original report.
defaults.ReportName: Report display name at extraction time. Use ReportId, not the name alone, to match access records.
defaults.Permission: Report or app access right returned by the relevant API. It is not a workspace RBAC role and does not identify how access was granted.
defaults.Source: API or metadata source from which this record was obtained. This identifies provenance, not whether a grant is direct or inherited.
defaults.GrantOrigin: Whether the source establishes direct versus inherited access. NotExposedBySource means the API does not provide that distinction.
defaults.PolicyFinding: NeedsReview: individual or entire-tenant access needs checking against the groups-only policy, not a confirmed breach. GroupPrincipal: group entry. NotEvaluated: another or unknown identity type.
defaults.Reason: Plain-language explanation of the row's assessment or coverage limitation. Read it together with the finding/status column.
defaults.AppName: App display name returned by the source. Names are not unique and do not establish an app's publication state.
defaults.AppType: ClassicApp, App, OrgApp or OrgAppAudience. Audience metadata items are not separate published apps, and app-level users are not audience membership.
defaults.LastUpdate: App update timestamp supplied by the catalogue, where available. This is not a history of app versions or proof of the latest publication.
defaults.PublicationStatus: Evidence available about publication: for example, ListedByAdminAppAPI or NotEstablished. Metadata existence alone does not prove publication.
defaults.AppWorkspaceId: Workspace associated with the app by the catalogue. It is not necessarily the workspace identifier of an original source report.
defaults.PublishedItemId: Identifier of the report or dashboard as returned in the app's published content. It can differ from OriginalReportId.
defaults.Coverage: Visibility limit of this content record. CallerVisibleOnly means the signed-in account's result is not a guaranteed tenant-complete app-content list.
defaults.DateUtc: UTC calendar date represented by this record. See Summary for the historical date range requested in this run.
defaults.EventId: Unique audit-event identifier. Duplicate event IDs are removed and counted in Activity coverage.
defaults.CreationTimeUtc: UTC event time recorded by the activity source, not the time the CSV/workbook was created.
defaults.Operation: Action recorded in the audit event, such as viewing a report. It is not a consumption measure or a permissions snapshot.
defaults.UserId: Actor identifier recorded by the activity event. It is not directory-enriched and may not always be a person's email address.
defaults.ObjectId: Object identifier recorded in this activity event; its meaning depends on the operation. Do not treat it as a Microsoft Entra user object ID.
defaults.ActivityId: Activity/correlation identifier supplied by the event source, where available. It is separate from the unique EventId.
defaults.IsSuccess: Success indicator supplied by the activity event. Blank means the event did not supply the field, not failure.
defaults.Collector: Part of the extraction package that recorded this issue, such as ReportAccess, AppContent or ActivityEvents.
defaults.Scope: Resource, date or feature to which the issue applies. It may be an identifier or a descriptive label.
defaults.Code: Stable issue category used by the script, for example ContentReadFailed or UnsupportedGrantOrigin.
defaults.Message: Explanation of a collection issue or coverage problem. Missing records must not be treated as an empty successful result when an error is recorded.
defaults.AccessCollection: Whether the report access-list read completed or failed. Complete means the list was read, not that direct grant origin was established.
defaults.DirectGrantAssessment: Availability of direct-versus-inherited grant assessment. Unsupported means the source lacks grant origin; Unavailable means collection failed.
defaults.AppPrincipalCollection: Status of reading app-level principals. Complete does not imply audience membership is known; Unsupported marks app types without this read route.
defaults.AudienceMembership: Availability of audience-to-recipient mapping. Unsupported means it could not be collected through the approved read-only sources, not that the audience is empty.
defaults.ContentType: App content category requested, such as reports or dashboards. Blank for an app type where the content route was unsupported.
defaults.Status: Outcome or coverage status for this row. Complete refers only to the supported read; Partial, Failed or Unsupported must not be interpreted as zero data.
defaults.Rows: Number of accepted/exported records for this source slice or content request. Read Status and Reason before interpreting zero.
defaults.ExportedRows: Number of activity events exported for this UTC day after deduplication and any requested capacity filtering.
defaults.MissingCapacityRows: Events excluded because a capacity filter was requested but the event had no CapacityId. Zero with no filter does not prove every event has a capacity.
defaults.DuplicateRows: Duplicate event IDs skipped during activity collection. Nonzero marks the day's coverage Partial even though duplicate output rows were removed.
defaults.Source CSV: Name of the retained CSV supplying the corresponding workbook table or filtered subset.
defaults.Workbook tab: Tab containing the represented source data. See Table header for its location.
defaults.Table header: Cell address where the table's column names begin.
defaults.Representation: How this run's source file is represented: copied table or a verified filtered subset.
defaults.Sheet: Workbook tab on which this documented column appears.
defaults.Section: Table or supporting-data section containing the column. A tab can contain several sections.
defaults.Column: Exact column name retained in the workbook.
defaults.Description: What this column shows, including units, missing-value meaning and important interpretation limits.
defaults.Records: Number of data rows in the source CSV, excluding headers. Zero does not mean successful collection; read the collector status and coverage.
defaults.Field: Name of a setting or scope value for this extraction run.
defaults.Value: Recorded value of this run setting. Dates and run timestamps are UTC.

WorkspaceAccess.csv.CapacityId: Identifier of the workspace's currently assigned dedicated capacity. Blank for shared capacity. It is not the capacity used by a historical activity event.

Workspaces.csv.CapacityId: Identifier of the workspace's currently assigned dedicated capacity. Blank for shared capacity. This is current placement, not historical placement.

Items.csv.CapacityId: Current capacity association from the workspace catalogue. This is not reconstructed historical placement.
Items.csv.CollectionStatus: Complete for a collected item identity, or Partial when collection/reconciliation identified an issue. Source-only identities remain visible rather than being discarded.

ReportAccess.csv.Reason: Why PolicyFinding has this value and what to check next. NeedsReview identifies individual or broad tenant access for review, not a proven direct-share violation.

AppPrincipals.csv.Permission: App-level access right returned by the classic app-user API. It is not a workspace role or audience-membership description.

AppAudienceCoverage.csv.Reason: Why app-level users cannot be interpreted as audience recipients and why audience membership remains unsupported.

AppContentCoverage.csv.Status: CallerVisibleOnly: supported read limited to the caller's access. Failed: content read failed. Unsupported: no approved route for this app type.
AppContentCoverage.csv.Reason: Visibility limitation, unsupported app-content route or specific read failure for this app/content category.
AppContentCoverage.csv.Rows: Number of content rows observed before this request finished or failed. Zero alongside Failed/Unsupported is not proof that the app has no content.

ActivityCoverage.csv.Status: Complete: paging completed for the requested UTC day without recorded exclusions/duplicates. Partial: coverage issue. Failed: the day's read did not finish.
